message.content: {"action":"change_rounding","reason":"All current direct and symmetric_preadd precision variants at or above the 60 dB threshold have been explored, and the smallest passing area is 7229.6 um^2 at coef_frac=12 symmetric_preadd. Further decreasing precision risks dropping below 60 dB (as seen at coef_frac=10 direct), while increasing precision has no legal unvisited neighbor. Changing rounding mode is the only action with legal unvisited neighbors and may reduce mapped area while preserving the required numerical quality."}
